## Goal

What were you trying to accomplish?

## Public step and version

Link the guide section and provide the commit or branch you used.
Include your operating system and Python version when relevant.

## Expected and observed behavior

What did you expect, and where did you stop?

## Minimal example

Include only fictional inputs and redacted errors. Do not attach private
memory, account data, configuration or unedited logs.

## Outcome

Did you complete the scaffold, stop at a confusing step, or encounter an error?
Please distinguish trying the public scaffold from installing a full runtime.
